Beige Book - October 2023 - National Summary

Overall Economic Activity

Economic activity increased slightly since the previous report. The outlook was generally stable, and contacts described steady conditions.

Labor Markets

Labor market tightness continued to ease. Employment grew at a modest pace and hiring proceeded on plan. Wage growth remained moderate.

Prices

Prices continued to increase at a modest rate. Sales prices held steady in most Districts.
